title: feat: add quest reward campaigns
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #13000

- Adds admin-managed coupon campaigns that redeem as hidden quests and immediately credit Quest Pollen.
- Adds an idempotent bulk grant endpoint for rewarding GitHub contributors by campaign, amount, reason, and source URL.
- Shows rewards without catalog entries in a dedicated Bonus rewards section with the normal claim flow.
- Reuses the existing reward ledger and balance claim transaction; no migration or direct balance adjustment.

Checks: 34 coupon, grant, and quest tests; Enter TypeScript; Biome; production frontend build.

gist.headline: Bonus pollen found
gist.blurb: The quest garden has a new hidden path: campaign rewards can bloom straight into your wallet. Contributors can now receive their Pollen without anyone manually tending a spreadsheet.
gist.summary: Added admin-managed coupon campaigns that redeem as hidden quests with immediate Quest Pollen credit, plus an idempotent bulk-grant endpoint for rewarding GitHub contributors by campaign, amount, reason, and source URL.
gist.impact: Users can claim campaign rewards through the normal quest flow and find uncatalogued rewards in a new Bonus rewards section, while maintainers can reliably grant contributor Pollen without direct balance adjustments.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy quest-reward garden where Polli discovers a hidden quest coupon blooming from a code-plant, while the eager CRT monitor robot distributes small Pollen jars to contributor seedlings. A retro quest board includes a clearly separate Bonus rewards nook, representing rewards that do not need catalog entries and still use the familiar claim path.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings, wearing a tiny gardener tool belt as she uncovers a hidden quest coupon growing from a lime green (#ecf874) code-plant; beside her, a cute chunky CRT-monitor robot happily places glowing Pollen jars into a wooden signpost labeled "BONUS REWARDS," surrounded by flowers and contributor seedlings. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, subtle CRT glow, nostalgic but beautiful.
